IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Takko, Kessler, Walsh, Rodne, Bailey, Roach, Anderson, and Morrell

Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing an online insurance verification system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an online insurance verification system; addingnew sections to chapter 46.30 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "online insurance verification system" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout this subchapterunless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Commercial automobile insurance coverage" means any insurancecoverage provided to an insured, regardless of the number of vehiclesor entities covered, under a commercial insurance coverage form andrated using either a commercial manual or rating rule and withoutregard to vehicle type and ownership. (2) "Commercial motor vehicle" means any motor vehicle registeredin this state and insured under commercial automobile insurancecoverage. (3) "Insurer" means an insurance company licensed or authorized todo business in this state. p. 1 HB 2695 (4) "Online insurance verification system" or "system" means anonline insurance verification system using web services. (5) "Personal motor vehicle" means a motor vehicle registered inthis state and insured under personal automobile insurance coverage andnot under commercial automobile insurance coverage.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "online insurance verification system" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall establish, within two years of theeffective date of this act, an online insurance verification systemusing web services for motor vehicles registered in this state. Inestablishing this system, the department shall: (a) Consult regularly with representatives of insurers indetermining the objectives and details of the system; (b) Provide for a testing period of more than nine months prior tothe establishment date required in subsection (1) of this section; (c) Publish a detailed user guide; and (d) Establish and maintain a contact person for insurers. (2) In establishing this system, the department may enter intocontracts with vendors or contractors.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "online insurance verification system" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The online insurance verification system must: (1) Be accessible by authorized personnel of the department fordirect inquiry. Access to the courts, insurers, and law enforcementmust be through authorized personnel of the department; (2) Be capable of verifying, on an on demand basis minus reasonabledown time for system maintenance as agreed upon by the state and theinsurer that is within reasonable experientially based timeframes, theliability insurance status of a vehicle with the insurer listed on anyinsurance identification card or in the department's records. Thisverification must be made available through the internet or othersimilar electronic systems and must be consistent with insuranceindustry specifications and standards; HB 2695 p. 2 (3) Be able to make insurance verification inquiries to insurersusing multiple data elements including, but not limited to, nationalassociation of insurance commissioners code, vehicle identificationnumbers, policy numbers, or other data elements agreed to by thedepartment and an insurer; (4) Provide sufficient measures for data security; and (5) Utilize open and agreed upon data and data transmissionstandards and standard schema.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "online insurance verification system" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each insurer shall: (a) Cooperate with the department in establishing and operating theonline insurance verification system; (b) Maintain the data necessary to verify the existence ofmandatory liability coverage provided to its customers pursuant to therequired time period for the online insurance verification system; (c) Maintain internet or similar service, pursuant to therequirements established for the online insurance verification system,through which online insurance verification can occur; (d) Provide adequate security consistent with insurance industrystandards; and (e) Provide commercial automobile insurance customers with aninsurance identification card clearly reflecting that the vehicle isinsured under a commercial motor vehicle policy. (2) Each insurer is immune from civil and administrative liabilityfor good faith efforts to comply with this subchapter. (3) Nothing in this subchapter prohibits an insurer from using theservices of a vendor to facilitate the establishment and operation ofthe online insurance verification system required under thissubchapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "online insurance verification system" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall: p. 3 HB 2695 (a) Cooperate with insurers in establishing and operating thesystem; (b) Maintain the list of authorized requesting entities andindividuals and incorporate that list as part of the system; (c) Conduct a pilot project to test the system prior to theestablishment date required under section 2(1) of this act; (d) Establish and maintain the systems necessary to makeverification requests to insurers using the data elements agreed to bythe department and the insurers; (e) For all information transmitted or received, implement andmaintain strict system and data security measures consistent withapplicable standards; (f) Keep all appropriate state agencies informed on theimplementation status, functionality, and service interruptions of thesystem; (g) Provide alternative methods, as determined by the department,of reporting for small insurers writing policies for no more than fivehundred vehicles in the state; (h) Work with insurers on issues related to the system to ensureequitable resolution; (i) Maintain historical records of system data for eighteen months;and (j) Provide a method to separately track motor vehicles owned by aqualified selfinsured. (2) Nothing in this subchapter prohibits the department from usingthe services of a vendor to facilitate the establishment and operationof an online insurance verification system required under thissubchapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "online insurance verification system" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall report to the transportation committees of thelegislature by July 1, 2014, regarding the operation of the onlineinsurance verification system including, but not limited to, the costsof system implementation and the effectiveness of the program in HB 2695 p. 4 reducing the number of uninsured drivers.
